title: Longest Video
prompt: Given the Material model in scope, implement `const Material* longest_video(const Material *ms, int n)` returning the VIDEO record with the most minutes, or NULL when there are none.

tests.name: winner
tests.code:
Material ms[] = {{1, VIDEO, 4}, {2, DOC, 9}, {3, VIDEO, 8}};
CHECK_EQ(longest_video(ms, 3), &ms[2]);
